newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air cargo at Frankfurt airport up 1.1pct in Feb 97.
newsitem.headline: Air cargo at Frankfurt airport up 1.1pct in Feb 97.

text.p: Total air cargo flown to and from Frankfurt airport (FRA) in February rose 1.1 percent year-on-year to 106,913 tonnes, airport authority figures showed.
Freight growth over the first two months of 1997 was 3.3 percent up at 207,874 tonnes, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) traffic report said.
The main growth area in February was foreign exports, particularly to North America, while imports stablised, the report noted.
Cargo flown on passenger aircraft in February rose 1.8 percent to 58,697 tonnes while cargo on freighter flights fell 0.8 percent to 45,079 tonnes.
